################################################################################
Purpose of script: To fit brms models to all the studies

# Set up
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("fun_ampphi.R")
library(ggridges)
library(tidybayes)
```

# 1. Assume a shape for the seasonality: 

# Based on a real model
```{r}
readRDS(glue("{dirs$coef}/coef_bmv1_s08_measl_cs.rds"))
```

```{r}
week <- 1:52
p_cos <- 0.005348973
p_sin <- 0.02413499

amp <- 0.02472062
phi <- 11.19498	
shape <- 2.48

nweek <- 100

dat <- data.frame(week = 1:52) %>%
  mutate(funcos = exp((p_cos*cos(2*pi*week/52)) + (p_sin*sin(2*pi*week/52)))) %>%
  mutate(funcos2 = (amp * cos(2*pi*week/52+phi)) + 1) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(funcos_obs = rnorm(1, mean = funcos, sd = 0.01),
         funcos_obsgamma = rgamma(n = 1, shape = 10^4, rate = 10^4/funcos))
dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = funcos)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_line(aes(y = funcos2), color = "red") + 
  geom_point(aes(y = funcos_obsgamma), color = "forestgreen") + 
  geom_point(aes(y = funcos_obs), color = "gold")
```

# 2. Sample
```{r}
dat <- data.frame(week = 1:52) %>%
  mutate(funcos = exp((p_cos*cos(2*pi*week/52)) + (p_sin*sin(2*pi*week/52)))) %>%
  uncount(nweek) %>% # expands each row nweek times
  mutate(funcos_obs = rnorm(n(), mean = funcos, sd = 0.01),
         funcos_obsgamma = rgamma(n(), shape = exp(shape), rate = exp(shape) / funcos)) %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  mutate(week_sample = 1:nweek)

dat %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(funcos_obs, funcos_obsgamma)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = funcos)) + 
  geom_point(aes(y = value), alpha = 0.3) + 
  geom_line(color = "grey") +
  facet_grid(~name)
```

3. Assume a normal distribution for the recruitment per week
```{r}
# Create a dataframe with number of samples to select per week based on a normal density
samples_per_week <- data.frame(week = 1:52) %>%
  mutate(
    rnormall = nweek,
    rnormsd8 = round(nweek * dnorm(week, mean = 25, sd = 8) / max(dnorm(week, mean = 25, sd = 8))),
    rnormsd4 = round(nweek * dnorm(week, mean = 25, sd = 4) / max(dnorm(week, mean = 25, sd = 4))),
    rnormsd2 = round(nweek * dnorm(week, mean = 25, sd = 2) / max(dnorm(week, mean = 25, sd = 2)))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("rnorm"), names_to = "dsample", values_to = "n_sample")

samples_tot <- samples_per_week %>%
  filter(n_sample != 0) %>%
  group_by(dsample) %>%
  summarise(tot = n())
samples_tot

samples_per_week %>%
  mutate(dsample = factor(dsample, levels = c("rnormall", "rnormsd8", "rnormsd4", "rnormsd2"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = n_sample)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_grid(dsample~.)
```

# 4. Simulate observed data: Implement recruitment from the samples
```{r}
# Now perform the sampling:
df_sampled <- dat %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Join to get numbe=r of samples per week
  pivot_longer(cols = c(funcos_obs, funcos_obsgamma), names_to = "dfun", values_to = "robs") %>%
  left_join(samples_per_week, by = "week", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(obs = case_when(week_sample <= n_sample ~ robs)) 

df_sampled %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = funcos)) + 
  geom_point(aes(y = obs), alpha = 0.1) + 
  geom_line(color = "grey") +
  facet_grid(dfun~dsample, scales = "free")
```

# Fit the models 
```{r}
dattests <- df_sampled %>%
  distinct(dfun, dsample)

mod_l <- list()
for(i in seq_len(length(dattests[[1]]))) {
  # Define model name
  mod_name <- paste0(dattests$dfun[[i]], "_", dattests$dsample[[i]])
  mod_l[[mod_name]] <- pomp::bake(
    file = paste0(dirs$outputs, "/simcosine/", mod_name, "_", nweek,".rds"), dir = "", {
      # Prepare the data 
      datmod <- df_sampled %>%
        filter(dfun == dattests$dfun[[i]], dsample == dattests$dsample[[i]]) %>%
        mutate(pi_week = week * (2*pi/52))
      # Select model family 
      mod_family <- if(dattests$dfun[[i]] == "funcos_obs") {
          gaussian(link = "identity") 
        } else if(dattests$dfun[[i]] == "funcos_obs_gamma") {
          Gamma(link = "identity")
        }
      # Run model
      mod <- brm(obs ~ cos(pi_week) + sin(pi_week), iter = 4000, data = datmod, family = mod_family)
      return(mod)
  })
}
```

# Plot the coefficients
```{r}
mod_coef <- lapply(mod_l, function(x) {
  as.data.frame(fixef(x)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Parameter") %>%
    mutate(True = c(1, p_cos, p_sin))
  }) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
  mutate(dfun = case_when(str_detect(mod, "gamma") ~ "funcos_obsgamma",
                          .default = "funcos_obs"),
         dsample = str_remove_all(mod, paste0(dfun, "_")),
         dsample = factor(dsample, levels = c("rnormall", "rnormsd8", "rnormsd4", "rnormsd2")),
         Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = c("Intercept", "cospi_week", "sinpi_week"))) 

mod_coef %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = dsample, color = dsample)) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = True), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "grey") +
    geom_point() + 
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5)) + 
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "rocket", end = 0.8) + 
    facet_grid(dfun~Parameter, scales = "free") + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Plot the conditional effects 
```{r}
plcon <- sapply(names(mod_l), function(x) {
  mod_tot <- filter(samples_tot, dsample == str_remove_all(x, "funcos_obsgamma_|funcos_obs_"))$tot[[1]]
  condf <- conditional_effects(mod_l[[x]], resolution = mod_tot)$pi_week
  return(condf)
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
  mutate(dfun = case_when(str_detect(mod, "funcos_obs_") ~ "funcos_obs",
                          str_detect(mod, "funcos_obsgamma_") ~ "funcos_obsgamma"), 
         dsample = str_remove_all(mod, paste0(dfun, "_")),
         pi_week = round(pi_week, digits = 6)) %>%
  right_join(mutate(df_sampled, pi_week = round(week * (2*pi/52), digits = 6)), 
             by = join_by(pi_week, dfun, dsample)) %>%
  mutate(dsample = factor(dsample, levels = c("rnormall", "rnormsd8", "rnormsd4", "rnormsd2"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = funcos)) + 
    geom_point(aes(y = obs.y), alpha = 0.1, color = "grey") + 
    geom_line() + 
    geom_line(aes(y = estimate__), color = "blue") + 
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.1, fill = "blue") + 
    facet_grid(dfun~dsample, scales = "free_y")

plcon
```

# Plot the samples
```{r}
spadf <- sapply(names(mod_l), function(x) {
  mod_tot <- filter(samples_tot, dsample == str_remove_all(x, "funcos_obsgamma_|funcos_obs_"))$tot[[1]]
  condf <- conditional_effects(mod_l[[x]], resolution = mod_tot, spaghetti = TRUE, ndraws = 100)
  spadf <- sapply(condf, function(subx) attr(subx, "spaghetti"), simplify = FALSE)$pi_week
  return(spadf)
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
  mutate(dfun = case_when(str_detect(mod, "funcos_obs_") ~ "funcos_obs",
                          str_detect(mod, "funcos_obsgamma_") ~ "funcos_obsgamma"), 
         dsample = str_remove_all(mod, paste0(dfun, "_")),
         pi_week = round(pi_week, digits = 6)) %>%
  right_join(mutate(df_sampled, pi_week = round(week * (2*pi/52), digits = 6)), 
             by = join_by(pi_week, dfun, dsample), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(dsample = factor(dsample, levels = c("rnormall", "rnormsd8", "rnormsd4", "rnormsd2"))) 

plspa <- spadf %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = funcos)) + 
    geom_line() + 
    geom_line(aes(y = estimate__, group = sample__), color = "blue", alpha = 0.05) + 
    facet_grid(dfun~dsample, scales = "free_y")
```

# Plot the amplitude and phase 
```{r}
# Check the names of the variables in brm
get_variables(mod_l[[1]])

# Sample from the posterior 
mod_samples <- sapply(names(mod_l), function(x) {
  spread_draws(mod_l[[x]], b_Intercept, b_cospi_week, b_sinpi_week, ndraws = 1000, seed = 100)
}, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
  mutate(dfun = case_when(str_detect(mod, "funcos_obs_") ~ "funcos_obs",
                          str_detect(mod, "funcos_obsgamma_") ~ "funcos_obsgamma"), 
         dsample = str_remove_all(mod, paste0(dfun, "_")),
         dsample = factor(dsample, levels = c("rnormall", "rnormsd8", "rnormsd4", "rnormsd2")),
         amp = fun_amp(b_cospi_week, b_sinpi_week), 
         phi = fun_phi(b_cospi_week, b_sinpi_week))

# Get estimates for the amplitude and phase
mod_coefwide <- mod_coef %>%
  select(mod, dfun, dsample, Parameter, Estimate, True) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Parameter, values_from = c(Estimate, True)) %>%
  mutate( 
    Estimate_amp = fun_amp(Estimate_cospi_week, Estimate_sinpi_week), 
    True_amp = fun_amp(True_cospi_week, True_sinpi_week),
    Estimate_phi = fun_phi(Estimate_cospi_week, Estimate_sinpi_week), ,
    True_phi = fun_phi(True_cospi_week, True_sinpi_week))

# Plot the amplitude and phase 
mod_samples %>%
  left_join(mod_coefwide) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = amp, y = dsample)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = True_amp), color = "gold") + 
  stat_density_ridges(quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), alpha = 0.7, scale = 0.9) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = Estimate_amp)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log2") + 
  facet_wrap(dfun~., scales = "free", ncol = 1) + 
mod_samples %>%
  left_join(mod_coefwide) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = phi, y = dsample)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = True_phi), color = "gold") + 
  geom_density_ridges(stat = "binline", bins = 52, scale = 0.95, draw_baseline = FALSE, scale = 0.9) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = Estimate_phi)) + 
  facet_wrap(dfun~., ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1,18,35,52), expand = c(0,0))
```
